content:
Created all three chart specifications with Chinese labels and sales in millions of yuan: the provincial distribution map, January–December area chart, and grouped category comparison for Guangdong and Jiangsu.

Guangdong leads the listed provinces at ¥15.8M. Monthly sales rise from ¥1.2M in January to ¥3.5M in December. Guangdong exceeds Jiangsu in all three product categories.

The provincial figures total ¥53.4M, while the monthly series totals ¥25.4M; confirm their reporting scopes before presenting them as the same annual total.
